prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art reference atlas for the existing NPC082 afraid/thinking eyes. Use the single attached 2x2 image as the exact portrait identity, emotion, palette, spacing, eye-opening shape, and blink-phase reference. Preserve this NPC's visible face, curly brown hair/head silhouette, muted warm skin, actual small muted gray-blue irises, and high worried/fearful brow shape. Keep the same pixel scale and low-resolution sprite rendering.

Canvas: one seamless two-column by two-row sheet, without margin, gutters, labels, extra faces, text, or decoration. Preserve the reference canvas ratio 1024:560 and the cell ratio 64:35. Cell order: top-left open eyes looking LEFT; top-right open eyes looking RIGHT; bottom-left half-blink eyes looking LEFT; bottom-right half-blink eyes looking RIGHT.

Keep the existing upper and lower eyelid contours and aperture width/height exactly the same as the reference in every cell: do not widen the eyes, expose more sclera, raise/lower a lid, or change the blink shape. The ONLY change between left and right cells is a gentle one-native-pixel horizontal shift of each existing compact iris and pupil within its current opening. Preserve the iris size and its actual muted gray-blue color. Keep the exposed sclera narrow and the same subdued beige as the source. Keep pupils fully inside the opening and keep the half-blink direction matching the open pose above. Use at most tiny mild warm glints consistent with the source, never bright white bands. Avoid larger irises, enlarged pupils, broad whites, extra highlights, square/bar-shaped eyes, disconnected or reshaped lids, brow/expression changes, perspective or face redesign, smoothing, antialiasing, blur, or any added content.
